history_policy: This version hash-inherits every V23 workload, representation, width, logical job count, checksum, execution mode, scored operation, attribution counter, allocation replay, timing boundary, and publication ruling. It changes only evidence integration: native runner snapshots now report exact measured-boundary user/system CPU deltas, exact-parent samples gate the unchanged sixty-percent occupancy threshold over that boundary, and complete-process occupancy remains diagnostic. Historical V1 artifacts and schemas remain byte-identical.
change: Re-pins evidence collectors and native runners after adding exact measured-boundary CPU-time telemetry. No workload source, representation, width, job count, checksum, Context option, execution mode, scored operation, attribution value, allocation replay, or performance acceptance changes.

exact_parent_integration.publication_boundary: Every new sample must report exact native user/system CPU deltas around the declared timed boundary and meet the unchanged sixty-percent occupancy threshold there. Whole-process wall/user/system/RSS observations remain diagnostic because they include startup, warmup, teardown, thermal queries, and allocation replay. Exact revisions, checksums, balanced sampling, thermals, cleanliness, and before/after competing-process guards remain fail-closed.

instrumentation_overhead_integration.evidence_ruling: V24 adds identity-checked parsing for the separate measured-boundary CPU-time row. Historical disabled-path samples and reports remain inherited byte-for-byte and are not reinterpreted.

context_lifecycle_integration.publication_boundary: V24 changes only the shared native telemetry row and runner hash. Lifecycle scenarios, options, checksums, phase/finalizer reconciliation, plateau policy, and evidence ruling are unchanged.

no_jit_integration.publication_boundary: V24 changes only measured-boundary CPU telemetry and the shared runner hash. Required-bytecode/no-native modes, logical work, checksums, attribution, quickening contracts, and exact-parent requirements are unchanged.

string_indexing_integration.publication_boundary: V24 preserves every V23 string-indexing representation, width, job count, checksum, required-bytecode boundary, attribution value, and exact allocation replay. New exact-parent evidence gates native CPU occupancy over the measured invocation and cannot turn diagnostic wall/cycle/energy observations into a public throughput claim.
